meta.title: Project I/O Module
meta.summary: Project Store、portable Bundle、session-kind journal 与 journaled atomic publication

cards.title: Dependencies
cards.body: Foundation + Authoring Domain. Committed inspection acquires the owner lease without authoring recovery or scavenging.

cards.title: Failure model
cards.body: Writer-lease admission closes mutation races; immutable command payload enables replay, while tail-last residual merge preserves only uncommitted owner-loss work.

cards.title: Session kinds
cards.body: The journal separates sequence and performance sessions; a Performance draft begins under the writer lease and resolves to save or discard.

cards.title: Forbidden boundary
cards.body: Bundle is transfer-only; Runtime Snapshot is never persisted as Project Truth. Slice lineage persists terminal evidence, never Workspace lifecycle state.
